plainSummary: Package creation now preserves the checkout during concurrent builds and failures while keeping consumer installs usable.
summary: Bounded review of npm packaging fixes: exact version dependencies match lockfile specifiers, .npmrc retains local workspace linking, mutating rewrite hooks/script are removed, and build prepack remains. Against archived PR HEAD, the new tests failed with server manifest workspace:* changed to 0.1.0-alpha.0 after overlapping packs and a backup left after failed prepack. Final command: PATH=/tmp/spec-ledger-pr1-tools:$PATH npm_config_cache=/tmp/sl-pack-break-npm-cache node --test packages/ledger/dist/pack.concurrency.break.test.js. Exit 0; 3 tests passed, 0 failed. Concurrent packs use isolated copies and a build barrier; generated client/server/ledger tarballs install offline and real module imports succeed. Failure injection confirms manifests remain byte-identical and backups absent. This review covers packaging only; other PR fixes are reviewed separately.
